description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when hand-writing MCP servers from scratch to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK) — no OpenAPI contract required. NOT when you already have an OpenAPI contract to convert (use mcp-server-builder).
